text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 3: UKV and ICON-D2 describe past wind best of the five products tested'
text.tspan: Figure 3: UKV and ICON-D2 describe past wind best of the five products

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each product against ERA5; each label gives the product's own error. The ICON-D2 and ICON global rows are exploratory. Bottom: the four planned contrasts, planned with the served 100 m wind; each ICON product was switched to its 80 m wind after the first run. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
